title: Technical Project Coordinator
description:
Job Description
**Noventiq is hiring!**
Noventiq (Noventiq Holdings PLC) is a leading global solutions and services provider in digital transformation and cybersecurity, headquartered in London. The company enables, facilitates, and accelerates digital transformation for its customers’ businesses, connecting 80,000\+ organizations across all sectors with a vast selection of best\-in\-class IT vendors, alongside its own services and solutions.
Noventiq delivered record gross revenue of $1\.6 billion for the 12 months to March 31, 2023, an increase of 52% in constant currency. The company’s growth is underpinned by its three\-dimensional strategy to expand its markets, portfolio, and sales channels. The strategy is supported by an active approach to M\&As which enables Noventiq to take advantage of the ongoing consolidation in the industry. Noventiq's 6,400 employees work in approximately 60 countries throughout Asia, Latin America, Europe, Middle East, and Africa—markets with significant growth potential.
* One of the largest SI’s in India with revenue close to 700M$ and growing to 900M$.


* 3500\+ Employees in India for India.


* Total 28 Offices in India across North, South, West \& East.


* 1000\+ Resident Engineers across India.


* 2500\+ technical resources in India for India.


* Technology partnerships with Top 3 Cloud Solution Providers, Top 3 Infrastructure companies, Top 10 Cybersecurity companies.


* Enviable customer base: 4 of Top 5 Banks, 3 of Top 5 IT companies, 3 of Top 5 BPO’s, 3 of Top 5 Pharma companies.


* Largest partner to Microsoft with combined infeed of US$600M about 25% of Microsoft India revenues.

  

  

**About You:**
* 3 years\+ in a Technical Project Management role dealing with large complex cloud migration / Innovation projects

* Recognised professional certification: PMP/Prince 2/CSPO/CSM/SaFe Agile

* Experience with different project management frameworks e.g., Waterfall, Agile including SCRUM, XP, Lean \& Kanban

* Strong analytical \& problem\-solving skills with a strong technical proficiency / comprehension

* Ability to work across team boundaries to get things done.

* Experience working with virtual teams across multiple time zones and cultures

* Deep experience of conflict management and proactive issue resolution

* Ability to positively influence customers and stakeholders, and properly manage divergent expectations

* Ability to manage internal as well as external resources in a virtual team of people implementing complex IT solutions

* Ability to directly manage multiple projects simultaneously

* Speak fluent International English

* Strong oral and written communications

* Strong sense of personal responsibility for delivering quality work

* Self\-motivated individual that possesses excellent time management and organisational skill

Excellent presentation skills with significant experience communicating to all interested stakeholders including Noventiq’s customers  

* 
  

**What you ‘ll do:**
* End to end project management of multiple Microsoft Azure Cloud Enablement and Innovation projects. (Migration \& Value Add services)

* Identify, clarify, and communicate the vision / objective(s) of the projects to all team members.

* Lead all customer facing conversations regarding project expectation setting, execution \& risks and issues management.

* Work closely with highly capable resources spread across the project value chain (Regional / in country management team, sales, solution sales, engineers, and architects. Centrally (GDC) based engineers and architects, OEM architects and consultants, customer IT function roles and stakeholders) to design, initiate and execute the end\-to\-end plan that delivers the service to the client.

* Bring a customer focused mindset with ability to multi – task and manage conflicting priorities, see the big picture while paying attention to the details and navigate complex processes with ease to deliver project goals and objectives on time, budget \& quality.

* Manage and track project scope, schedule and budget while proactively mitigating risks that could impact milestones and deliverables.

* Comfortably lead discussions, regularly communicating with senior leadership across the whole project in Noventiq, its vendors and the customer. Be able to translate technical details into business language to enabling decision making across the project.
  

  

**What we offer:**
* Insurance – Group Medical Coverage, Group Personal Accident, Group Term Life Insurance


* Rewards and Recognition Program, Employee Referral Program, Wellness Program and CSR Initiatives


* Maternity and Paternity Leaves


* Company Sponsored Certification Program


* Learning/Development Courses, Cross Skill, Mentorship and Leadership Programs


* Quarterly Performance Feedback Sessions


* Savings, Investments and Retirement Benefits


* Flexible Work Hours, Work from Home, Remote Working, Hybrid Working


* Company Onsite / Fun Events

  

  

**Don’t forget to include your CV and cover letter. We receive a lot of applications, but we try to notice each of our potential candidates.**

We are looking for an experienced AI Technical Lead with 10\+ years of software engineering experience and strong expertise in Python, and AI\-powered application development, Generative AI, LLMs, and agentic AI solutions. Experience with React\-based front\-end development and AWS cloud technologies would be advantageous.


The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of leading engineering teams, architecting scalable solutions, and delivering modern AI\-enabled applications leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and cloud\-native technologies.


The successful candidate will provide technical leadership across the full software development lifecycle, mentor developers and AI engineers, collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders, and drive innovation through the adoption of AI and modern engineering practices.

* Design and implement RESTful APIs and backend services using Python and modern software engineering practices.

Qualifications

* Experience with AWS cloud services, application architecture, and modern DevOps practices.

* Python

* Experience with AWS cloud services, including EC2, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent cloud technologies.
* Familiarity with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or similar technologies

**Job Description**

**Senior Technical Project Manager \- Supply Digital Technology**

**Job Purpose / Overview**


This role exists to provide senior technical project management leadership for the Food \& Nutrition Supply Digital Technology portfolio, ensuring critical Supply DT initiatives are delivered with quality, pace, strong governance and clear business value.


The role will drive the delivery of digital and technology projects across key Supply capabilities, including Thema / Supply Data Foundations, Planning capabilities such as Blue Yonder, and Smart Manufacturing / Industry 4\.0 solutions.


The Senior Technical Project Manager will coordinate business, DT, data, architecture, security, vendor and delivery teams to move initiatives from concept through design, build, testing, deployment, transition and benefit realization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of Supply Digital Technology projects across Food \& Nutrition, covering data foundations, planning, manufacturing and analytics capabilities.
* Manage project delivery across the full lifecycle, including demand shaping, business case support, concept and initiation, design, build, test, deployment, hypercare, project closure and transition to support.
* Drive delivery of Supply DT initiatives such as Thema / Supply Data Foundations, Blue Yonder planning enhancements, and Smart Manufacturing / Industry 4\.0 capabilities, ensuring each initiative has clear scope, milestones, dependencies, risks and success measures.
* Coordinate internal teams, third\-party vendors, system integrators, data partners and business stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within agreed budget and to expected quality standards.
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, RAID logs, dependency maps, governance materials, financial tracking and status reporting for senior DT and business stakeholders.
* Translate business objectives and Supply pain points into actionable delivery plans, working closely with Supply leaders, Business Partners, Product Owners, Data teams, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, GDO and functional SMEs.
* Ensure technical delivery activities are aligned with architecture, cybersecurity, data governance, integration, service introduction and operational support standards.
* Partner with Supply business stakeholders to support business readiness, UAT planning, deployment preparation, adoption tracking and post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Manage delivery risks and issues proactively, escalating where required and driving clear decisions through appropriate governance forums.
* Support vendor and partner management, including input to Statements of Work, delivery plans, resource models, deliverable acceptance and performance management.
* Ensure project documentation is complete, controlled and suitable for transition to support teams, including business process documentation, technical design artefacts, testing evidence, cutover plans and operational handover materials.
* Work with Finance and PMO stakeholders to support budget planning, capitalization requirements, cost tracking, forecast updates and benefits realization.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery ways of working, including stronger use of PMX, agile/hybrid delivery methods, lessons learned, reusable templates and project governance discipline.
* Build strong relationships across global and regional Supply teams to ensure delivery plans reflect business priorities, local deployment realities and global template requirements.
* Act as a senior delivery leader within the Supply DT team, providing coaching, structure and delivery discipline to project teams, vendors and junior project resources where required

 **Context and Scope**

  

The role operates within the Food \& Nutrition Supply Digital Technology team, partnering closely with Supply business leaders, regional business partners, functional SMEs, DT delivery teams, Data \& AI, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, GDO, Finance, PMO and external vendors.


The portfolio includes initiatives that enable Supply Chain visibility, planning effectiveness, data\-driven decision making, factory performance improvement and digital adoption across Food \& Nutrition. These include data and analytics foundations through Thema, planning capabilities involving Blue Yonder, and Smart Manufacturing capabilities such as connected worker, factory data, operational visibility and predictive insights.


The role must balance strategic ambition with practical delivery constraints, ensuring projects are planned realistically, governed effectively and delivered in a way that creates sustainable business value. The role will work across regions and functions, often influencing without direct authority and managing delivery through a combination of internal resources, vendors, contractors and cross\-functional teams.


The Senior Technical Project Manager will be expected to operate comfortably with senior stakeholders, manage ambiguity, resolve delivery blockers, and bring structure to complex initiatives that span process, data, technology, integration and change

 **Job Specifications / Qualifications**

**Education \& Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Supply Chain, Business Management or a related discipline.
* Project Management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM or equivalent is preferred.
* Agile, Scrum, SAFe or hybrid delivery certification is desirable.
* Additional knowledge or certification in Supply Chain planning, data platforms, manufacturing systems or cloud/data technologies would be advantageous

**Knowledge / Experience**


Required:

* Experience delivering technology projects, with significant experience in digital transformation, Supply Chain, manufacturing, planning, data or enterprise technology environments.
* Proven experience as a senior Project Manager, Technical Project Manager, Delivery Manager or equivalent role leading cross\-functional technology delivery.
* Strong experience managing full project lifecycle delivery, including planning, governance, budget tracking, RAID management, stakeholder reporting, testing, deployment, hypercare and transition to support.
* Experience delivering projects involving complex stakeholder groups across business, DT, data, architecture, security, vendors and operations.
* Strong understanding of Supply Chain processes, ideally including planning, S\&OP, manufacturing, inventory, logistics, data and analytics.
* Experience working with or around planning platforms such as Blue Yonder, SAP planning capabilities or equivalent enterprise Supply Chain systems.
* Experience with data and analytics delivery, including data platforms, dashboards, reporting solutions, data governance, data quality and Power BI or equivalent analytics tools.
* Experience delivering manufacturing, Smart Manufacturing, Industry 4\.0, connected worker, factory data, automation or operational technology initiatives is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to manage third\-party vendors, system integrators and delivery partners, including delivery governance, SoW input, milestone tracking and deliverable acceptance.
* Strong financial discipline, including budget tracking, forecasting, capitalization awareness and benefits realization.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical delivery topics into clear business\-facing updates and senior stakeholder messages.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, prioritization and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to work globally across cultures, time zones and business functions.

 **Preferred Experience**

* Experience working in Food, CPG, FMCG or manufacturing environments.
* Experience with DT delivery methods, PMX, ServiceNow, GDO transition, cybersecurity review and enterprise architecture governance.

title: DB Performance Architect(Oracle, PostgreSQL, AWS, Performance Tuning, Terraform)
description:
Our fast\-paced and collaborative environment inspires us to create, think, and challenge each other in ways that make our solutions and our teams better. Whether you’re interested in engineering or development, marketing or sales, or something else – if this sounds like you, then we’d love to hear from you!



We are headquartered in Denver, Colorado, with offices in the US, Canada, and India.


We are seeking a Cloud Database Architect with deep database expertise, strong Infrastructure as Code experience, and hands\-on AWS database platform knowledge. The ideal candidate will have proven experience designing Terraform solutions from the ground up **rather than simply executing or maintaining existing pipelines**, leading complex database migrations and upgrades, driving performance optimization initiatives, and architecting highly available and resilient database platforms on AWS. * Design, develop, and maintain Terraform modules and deployment standards for database infrastructure.
* Troubleshoot Terraform state, drift, and deployment issues across AWS environments.
* Drive automation of provisioning, patching, upgrades, backups, and operational activities.
* Lead cloud migration, upgrade, and modernization initiatives.

title: Director of Engineering - Studio Team
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.


Living our values everyday results in our team\-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.


The Five9 Studio engineering team drive the realization of practical AI solutions for the contact centre environment. Our existing Studio product stack is built on Laravel Framework\-PHP, Python and Vue.js technology deployed in private and public clouds. We leverage the latest cloud AI services such as OpenAI, Google Speech and Dialogflow, Deepgram, IBM Watson and Wellsaid and integrate into Five9 wider well\-developed microservices platform.



Our vision for practical AI involves equipping contact centre agents, supervisors and managers with user interfaces that guide and summarize their work, identify points of coaching and support, and fully automate routine interactions. This latter part is the focus of the Studio Engineering team, enabling our customers to create and tune implementation of AI agents into their voice and digital channels for their end\-customer self\-service and steering to best agent.


**Role purpose**



The purpose of this role is to build and lead a team of developers and quality assurance that will design, develop, and maintain software solutions and drive the implementation of best practices in continuous integration, continuous delivery and service ownership within a fast\-paced environment.



This role requires a hands\-on approach and while it spends some time undertaking development, it will ultimately contribute to delivering exceptional customer experience.


**How you contribute**


* Lead and mentor a team of software development engineers responsible for designing, implementing, monitoring and tooling our cloud services.
* Identify and hire suitable employees in partnership with the Talent Acquisition team.
* Provide coaching, feedback, and development opportunities to enhance skills, motivation, and performance of team members.
* Oversee the design, development, and implementation of features and functionality aligning with the feature goals. Ensure adherence to best practices, standards, and security protocols.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and quality assurance professionals, to ensure that everyone is aligned around goals and progress.
* Drive the adoption of modern technologies, tools and practices to streamline development workflows, improve efficiency, and enhance the quality and reliability of our software.
* Apply strong understanding of various programming languages, frameworks, and development methodologies, to enable informed decisions and solve complex technical challenges.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues by applying problem\-solving skills to identify the root causes and implement effective solutions.
* Manage relationships with cloud service providers, tool vendors, and other external partners.
* Drive a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning within the team and across the organization.
* Apply a can do "attitude" and finds solutions for complex distributed problems.
* Take part in roadmap planning and manage execution process
* Collaborate with leadership on long\-term vision, and strategy


**Skills, competencies and qualifications**


* 8\+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* A portfolio of past projects showcasing backend and full stack development skills, preferably on a cloud based platforms (GCP, AWS or Azure).
* Proficiency and strong experience in one or more backend languages / technologies as PHP, Python, Java, and familiarity with frontend Javascript frameworks such as REACT and or Vue.JS
* In\-depth understanding of microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems. Telephony and SIP desirable.
* Experience with QA automation, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps best practices, preferably hands\-on experience developing services in a containerization environment
* Awareness of security best practices and the ability to implement security measures to protect applications and data.
* Demonstrates critical thinking with sound analytical, debugging skills
* Strong commitment to delivering high\-quality code and solutions on time and within scope.
* Strong communicator who can express thoughts and ideas clearly and effectively.
* Demonstrated experience building strong cross functional team relationships.
* Demonstrated ability to hire and onboard developers at rapid rate.
* Experience in developing and/or assessing processes and procedures and drive meaningful improvements.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively with multiple teams across various time zones.
* Prior experience managing remote and distributed staff.
* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in relevant discipline.


**Other requirements**


* This position requires the ability to be On Call.


**Key relationships**



Manages a team of up to 15 – 25 Engineers and Managers



Key stakeholders include:


* Product Managers
* Product Architects
* Quality Assurance Team
* Cloud Platform team


Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.



View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9\.com/pt\-pt/legal.  

  



Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9\.

title: Threat Intelligence Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  

  

  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

  

  

Docusign is seeking a Cyber Threat Intelligence Engineer to join our Threat Intelligence team. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain infrastructure, tools, and capabilities that enables the Threat Intelligence team to perform threat intelligence analysis and dissemination. You will create tools, automations, dashboards, data pipelines, and integrations that enable fast, scalable, and centralized access to threat intelligence data. The ideal candidate will have strong engineering skills and past experience in security operations.

  



This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager of the Threat Intelligence team.

  



**Responsibility**


* Architect, construct, and maintain robust infrastructure for collecting, processing, storing, and analyzing cyber threat intelligence data
* Implement engineering best practices to maximize data quality and operational visibility for threat analysis
* Develop and deploy scalable automation workflows to streamline threat intelligence operations
* Collaborate with analysts to translate operational requirements into high\-performing, reliable technical solutions
* Produce technical documentation, interactive dashboards, and key metrics to measure system performance and business impact

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  

  

  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)  

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.  

  

**What you bring**
------------------

  

  

  

**Basic**

* 3\+ years of proven experience in cyber threat intelligence engineering, incident response, security automation, or data engineering
* Hands\-on experience leveraging Generative AI for security operations, including prompt definition, model benchmarking, and integrating scalable AI solutions into intelligence workflows
* Demonstrated ability to configure, deploy, and maintain threat intelligence platforms (TIPs) and integrate structured threat data into enterprise security tools
* Proficiency in creating and managing interactive Python notebooks (e.g., Jupyter, Marimo), configuring data connections, building reusable workflows, and documenting analytical processes
* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  

**Preferred**

* Experience designing and operating cloud\-based data platforms, automation services, and infrastructure\-as\-code in AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Proficiency with Git\-based development practices, including branching, pull requests, code review, CI/CD, and automated testing
* Experience integrating threat intelligence platforms with enterprise security tools, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, and case\-management systems
* Knowledge of threat intelligence standards and data technologies, including STIX/TAXII, MITRE ATT\&CK, Python, SQL, APIs, and relational, graph, or search databases
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  

  

  

**Working here**
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.  

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.  

**Accommodation**
Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.  

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.
